channel.title: Cameroon - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Cameroon, every source cited.

item.title: Cameroon bauxite project awaits CFA36.5 billion loan
item.description: AFG Bank Cameroon will inspect the Minim-Martap bauxite site in November before deciding on CFA36.5 billion loan release.

item.title: UNESCO gives Cameroon computers for education monitoring
item.description: The organization provided 25 laptops and technical equipment to improve learning assessments.

item.title: Chinese firm eyes $63.0M sugar, rice investment in Cameroon
item.description: Nanning Agricultural Development Group is considering large-scale plantations and a processing complex in Batouri.

item.title: Cameroon refugee artisans seek wider markets
item.description: Over 135 refugees in East Region receive vocational training and access to sales outlets.

item.title: Cameroon to raise 2027 public investment budget
item.description: The government aims for a significant rise in public investment next year but may miss its 40% budget target.
